notes.title: Community Gameplay Thursdays Are Here!
notes.content:
Weekly Community Gamplays are About to Begin

You. Yes, you! Nerd Monkeys has the pleasure to invite all players to our community gameplay days on Monkey Split!

Help us make Monkey Split the best cute multiplayer monkey tag game on Steam! Ambitious, we know. Your opinions are valuable to us and we can always use this time to have fun with our players out there

If you want to stay in the loop, get social with all the monkeys and deliver your feedback straight to the source, then slide onto our Discord.

During August, every Thursday from 17h00 to 18h00 (GMT+1)*!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39210376/b73738473a4df06064432078e7d53d3fab2b4e0e.png

And don't forget to add Monkey Split to your Wishlist so you receive the latest from your favorite apes!

See you there, monkeys! ːsteamhappyː

*This schedule may suffer adjustments according to players' feedback, so stay tuned.

notes.title: Devlog #2 The one where I got late
notes.content:
Hello fellow monkeys.

I know, I know. You will start “bUt YoU SaId EvErY fRiDaY”, true, I did say that. But then Christmas happened, and vacations happened, and nothing really happened, so I did not thought that a devlog was useful. But this week, so much happened that we needed to come back.

But sorry for the delay and let’s do this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39210376/7ffc7441094754dd378780bd4cbd11b3d2c5535a.gif

Soooo… The news.

First of all we will need to postpone the beta test that would happen next week to the 29th of January.

The change in date is because our monkeys are finding difficult to type in a keyboard and the following reasons:

[olist]
 We are experiencing several issues with the Unreal Engine 4.26:

 First we had the following problem

 Cannot create SoftObjectPath with short package name 'NoneNone'! You must pass in fully qualified package names
 The solution I achieved was to edit the Engine file (“SoftObjectPath.cpp”) and change the 72 Line
 if (Path.IsEmpty() || Path.Equals(TEXT("None"), ESearchCase::CaseSensitive) || Path.Equals(TEXT("NoneNone"), ESearchCase::CaseSensitive))

 
Second, this error we are still experiencing and we cannot package a new build for you guys. (If you know how to correct please help us out, as we are out of ideas)

 UEdGraphPin::BreakLinkTo Pin 'In' on node 'Unknown' not reciprocally linked with pin 'Out' on node 'Mesh'


 We fully changed the concept we had for the menus:
[/olist]

In retrospective we think that they were too close to other games like Fall Guys and we wanted ours to feel, well…, ours.

So in the following images you can see some concepts we thought about, the idea was to go 3D with it and integrate the buttons on the environment,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39210376/5c66bf7c86dbc14ea0d3b89ffe13da923b35d425.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39210376/33393afe2d45f7aeb46c59363a39e4c251ce747a.png

These ideas were also scrapped after we were incapable of producing cute and kawaii bananas.
Yep, our awesome team could only produce high quality bananas that weren’t on the correct vibe of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39210376/fdba599893cd070ff9e54c309e202ae068dc2c56.png

Like these bananas, what is going on with them.

So in the end we went with a more traditional and simple menu. We used normal 2d images for it. It is still in production but you can see here some concepts for the buttons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39210376/c76834bb08900b17bbba227258ea17a53e6aa97e.png

We are also introducing, *play the drums*

A Settings Menu, so you can change the resolution and other graphical settings, YEAHHHHH, so innovative.

We are also reworking the number of menus. So now after you click on host a game you will be sent to a new menu where you can define different settings for the game, like the number of objects and the map.

Isn’t that exicting? 

Other than this there weren’t any new features added to the game.

We have been working more on correcting bugs and code improvements so it is a more fluid experience for you guys.

We are closely working with the community on our discord. Right now we are trying to decide with everyone the name of our “stalker monkey” if you want to help just go there and talk with us.

Nerd Monkeys also created a subreddit where you can go and post about anything, okay, not about ANYTHING, but you know the drill. (https://www.reddit.com/r/nerdmonkeys/)

And to finalize this testament this is what we want for our next build:

A kawaii and functional menu.
The skybox, that ugly thing, we hope it will be fixed.
Less bugs.
Less crashes.
More fun.


And that’s it, anything hit me on discord on the #monkey-split, I am there 25/7 as a slave monkey.

Hope everyone is okay and stay safe, hope to see you on the next devlog.

Computer Wizard Abrams

notes.title: Devlog #1 The one where it all begun
notes.content:
Hello fellow monkeys.

This is new for me (your humble codemonkey known as Abrams), devlogs and writing in general, hope you can cope with me and have fun while reading. But I will try my best! 💪

So this past week was huge for us and you guys, we finally were able to make our first playtest through steam. Maybe for you guys it’s not a big deal, but for us, it was huge, like, really huge. 

https://media1.tenor.com/images/f270af67ed4bd0b74f477f3bad8cb540/tenor.gif?itemid=4824556

First of all thanks for everyone that played it, hope you had a blast. Second, a huge thanks to everyone that reported bugs or made suggestions, everything was compiled and added to the backlog of our trello project. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you.
Now to the real part of the devlog, what have we been up to. 👀

We know that both the water and skybox are not in accordance with the game vibe, yet, so we have been trying to think about solutions. For the skybox we are between just a normal 2D skybox, it’s nice, it’s easy but something is missing, and we want to do something amazing here. The other option is to have volumetric clouds, like, clouds that move and transform like a more realistic sky but always with a cartoonish look. We are still deciding between which option suits the vibe of the game better, but, as soon as we have both implemented we will post them so you can decide.
Here you have a random screenshot of the new skybox.

https://i.imgur.com/KcdWMYc.png

Well, there it is, Not much, but something new.

The menus will also need a revamp, so in the next couple of weeks we will try to improve the following:

 A new wonderful and cute skybox.
 Menus, but now not something done by a programmer, real nice menus.
 Correction of a lot of bugs, and when I say bugs I don’t mean little spiders, I mean real bugs like in Australia, we don’t get that kind in Portugal.


I will try to post a new devlog every Friday. Don’t promise I will be able to, because sometimes monkey Stuart puts me to slave work but I really want to do it. I Hope you read and enjoy them.

For suggestions, creation of assets or just improvements on the devlog just comment or post here in our Steam Community or go to Nerd Monkey’s Discord channel and talk with us, we’re there 24/7 like monkeys in a cage (don’t let the boss monkey not so Lord Stuart see this)

Computer Wizard Abrams

notes.title: It's Playtest time
notes.content:
Monkey Split will be open for playtest for a few days!

Help us test this prototype and suggest all sorts of improvements and details about the game, it's still in a very rough state and we want to work with the community to help shaping it into something fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39210376/c59fd943fcf370af9e1ab34d5da071d7e8f42bac.jpg

This is a bit of an experiment for ourselves as well, making a game while going with the flow, but we will do our best and we will be listening closely to everyone and taking notes. ;)

Share all the bugs, screenshots, videos etc. in the community.

Ask all the questions about why and how things are being built.

Trust nobody, not even yourself! There's a conspiracy afoot*.

🙈🙊🙉

* Conspiracy will be later added as a DLC.
